name: Dashboards Extra
description: Add Multi Statistics block to Dashboards
project_description: Dashboards Extra extends the Dashboards module (which provides the @Dashboard plugin type and the dashboard UI) by shipping seven ready-made statistics widgets. Each widget is a Dashboard plugin in the "Dashboards: Extras" category that runs an aggregate entity-count query and renders the result as a chart (pie/bar/etc. via the Dashboards ChartTrait). Provided widgets: Content Statistics and My Content Statistics (node counts per content type, overall or authored-by-current-user), Block Statistics and My Block Statistics (block_content counts per block type), Media Statistics (media counts per bundle), Vocabulary Statistics (taxonomy_term counts per vocabulary) and Users Statistics (user counts per role). The module has no routes, services, permissions, config schema, hooks or Drush commands of its own; all configuration is per-widget through the Dashboards editing UI.
